phases.title: Create
phases.text: My professional path started on the creative side: graphic design, video production, music production and DJing. Creating brands, media and digital experiences gradually evolved into building products and businesses of my own.

phases.title: Structure
phases.text: Creating became building. I began building companies, digital products and technology infrastructure — moving from creating individual outputs to creating systems around them.

phases.title: Professionalize
phases.text: Building became professionalizing. Working within banks, professional-services firms and global corporations added another perspective: how established institutions manage complexity, risk, transformation and scale.

phases.title: Automate
